doc: Reachy Mini -> MARS plan-space retargeting. Reachy features are measured relative to `rest` (mm / deg, Reachy +pitch = head DOWN, ear droop 0 = up, 150 = drooped). `linear` rows: MARS channel = sum(coef * feature). Ears: `upness` is piecewise linear in the mean droop (rest -> 0, up_deg -> +1, down_deg -> -1); expand = upness * expand_gain; grip = interp(upness, grip_points) + flick_gain * max(0, flick - flick_deadband_deg) / flick_full_deg, where flick is the larger |ear droop - lowpass(ear droop, flick_hz)| of the two ears (fast ear flicks survive as the mouth). Every channel is then clipped to CONTRACTS §1 ranges. Finally each channel's detail above detail_hz is scaled by detail_gain (posture untouched): Reachy's head and ear detail is several times larger, in units of the core's plan.ENERGY_SCALE, on the arm channels than on attend, which would put Reachy-ear-speed wiggles on MARS's arm; the gains bring every channel's detail to the head's level, except grip, which keeps the ear flicks as mouth chatter.
